visual_logic.surface_detail: Thick, leathery 'Slate Grey' skin covering the dorsal ribs; skin has a tactile, weathered-tarp texture with barnacle-like scarring along its expansive horizontal profile.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate measurement comparisons. Hero focus is on the massive, hooked raptorial beak oriented parallel to the frame edge, with the large front flippers flattened toward the camera plane.
visual_logic.facial_expression: Wise and ancient; large, dark eyes with heavy, drooping lids facing laterally in a calm, methodical gaze.

environment.water: Deep indigo water with high-key 'god-rays' illuminating the suspended marine snow in the background.
environment.biota: A school of small Enchodus fish is pushed to the lower background layer beneath its massive shell to keep the turtle's horizontal silhouette line perfectly clean and unobstructed.

visual_logic.pose: The giant sea turtle is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original upward angle is flattened into a level, straight cruising path, extending its head, carapace, and rear flippers end-to-end to cleanly trace alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
